svg.text: Frozen 12-drawing snapshot / qualitative art review / native samples at 100% / geometry unchanged
Yellow oval and circles; no protruding beak or readable duck head.
A rubber duck cannon that bounces angry little ducks around corners. Big squeaks,
Trays suggest office machinery; paper feed survives better than fax identity.
A furious office fax machine that fires every rejected invoice at once.
Open handle and pointed spout carry identity without violet colour.
A teapot containing a tiny black hole. Pour one extremely bad idea at a time.
Pink/yellow dots and fins; no cactus lobes or needle comb.
A disco cactus that sneezes a fan of glittering needles.
Plain barrel is the fallback. Rejected lantern geometry is unavailable.
A jellyfish lantern whose tentacles braid into a painfully focused beam.
Pink chamber suggests gum; at 32 px it reads mainly as a round launcher.
A bubblegum mortar that launches enormous gum bubbles which pop spectacularly.
